title: Calcium–phosphate coupling does not establish incremental digit-symbol prediction across separately sampled NHANES cycles
abstract: Calcium–phosphate coupling did not establish incremental DSST prediction: target weighted MSE reduction 0.00075266 score²; joint source-refit/target PSU-bootstrap 95% interval [-6.16240, 5.32861]. Development used1257 NHANES2011–2012 adults aged60+ and transfer evaluation used1465 separately sampled2013–2014 adults. Baseline includes flexible separate minerals, albumin, creatinine and conventional cognitive covariates. Source CV and sensitivities do not support a robust gain. This exploratory negative representation test is not equivalence or external-cohort validation.
